row.notes: Evaluates the pending flag check and writes a state byte to out_state: with no active check (+0x1c8 == 0) returns task+0x134; else logs the four masks (+0x180 wanted, +0x130 done, +0x128 requested, +0x12c in flight) on F1W-OS, and if wanted bits are not done returns 2 after OR-ing them into +0x128 and restarting timer +0x100/+0x108, 3 if already requested, or 6 when [+0x68]+0x39 is clear; state 3 also while any wanted bit is still in +0x128/+0x12c. When all are done it calls the completion functor +0x1c0 with +0x134 (state 6 with +0x71 set forces offline mode and shows message 'f1world_warning_incomplete_data'), then clears the check slot +0x180. show_spinner starts busy spinner type 7 on [+0x1d0]. Caller Game_F1os_SetCheckFlagsAndRefresh stores new flags and functor then calls it; Game_F1os_F1WorldTask_OnRequestResult calls it with 0 after merging +0x12c into +0x130 to re-evaluate after each request result. (lab L1 re-check with caller context 2026-11-27)
